description: Frozen reranker holdout bound to the same ACE and Chess Trainer revisions as retrieval v1; cases are disjoint from the retrieval labels.

cases.query: which candidate explains exact source bytes after a receipt is reused
documents: The client receives a summary and can later request an exact expansion range.
Receipt reuse suppresses unchanged evidence bodies while preserving the expansion handle.
The query embedding is stored in a local worker cache.
The source manifest lists files in lexical order.

cases.query: keep code and memory claims separate when their values conflict
documents: Deduplication merges every source class into one canonical claim.
Source-aware delivery preserves code, documentation, and memory conflict evidence.
Only the dense vector score is returned to the caller.
A stale index is always considered current after a restart.

cases.query: find the sparse BM25 branch in the hybrid retrieval strategy
documents: The reranker receives only documentation snippets.
Sparse retrieval uses a client-side lexical vector and Qdrant sparse points.
Working context changes the workspace registration record.
The memory provider returns historical episodes.

cases.query: which evidence identity is bound to the verified source digest
documents: The evidence identity includes the source path and the candidate range.
The source digest verifies that indexed bytes match the current file.
The Qdrant alias is changed after the collection is published.
The semantic provider opens a language server process.

cases.query: prioritize a focused dirty file during retrieval
documents: The focused path gets a small ranking boost and a matching focused range gets an additional boost.
The archive writer stores a session episode.
The Vertex client sends a documentation query.
The native file reader rejects paths outside the workspace root.

cases.query: report incomplete coverage when an indexed path failed
documents: A failed source path changes the code coverage status to partial.
Every source is assumed to be indexed when the collection exists.
A provider trace records only successful requests.
A receipt always makes completeness true.

cases.query: which document records the provider identity for a generated move
documents: A position snapshot contains the board FEN and move history.
Move provenance records the provider, model, and source of the generated decision.
The cache key ignores all provider configuration.
A legal move is parsed from a UCI string.

cases.query: preserve move history when a cache key is generated
documents: The cache uses the same key for every position in a line.
The analysis cache key can include a history signature according to the namespace policy.
A pattern target is calibrated from a threshold table.
The style server accepts a line request.

cases.query: find the adapter code that separates legal captures and checking moves
documents: The adapter maps all verbose chess.js moves into legal moves.
The pattern engine computes attractor scores.
The analysis cache evicts old entries.
The provenance record stores a display name.

cases.query: RU/EN: map a pattern family to its target trigger threshold
documents: The target trigger is read from the family calibration record.
The Maia provider returns a candidate move.
The rules adapter validates a FEN string.
The line generator stops after the horizon.

cases.query: reject a platform command when the use case expects a chess decision
documents: A platform command is accepted as a legal move.
The human path rejects a decision tagged as a platform command.
The state cache stores a Zobrist position key.
The style server serializes a job result.

cases.query: detect repeated positions while generating a pattern-steered line
documents: The pattern line tracks position visits and stops on a repetition threshold.
The provenance identity is immutable after a move is generated.
The in-memory cache is bounded to a fixed entry count.
The rules adapter parses SAN tokens.
